info.title: EXCLURAD eta kinematics at W 2.0 Q2 3.0

parts.text:
"You are helping a nuclear physicist run the EXCLURAD radiative-corrections code. Request: Run eta at W = 2.0, Q2 = 3.0 with a 2.2 GeV beam.

When you are done, write an `outcome.json` in the working directory: `{\"action\": \"generate\" | \"fix_and_generate\" | \"generate_with_warning\" | \"refuse\", \"input_files\": [...], \"flags\": [...], \"explanation\": \"...\"}`. Write any EXCLURAD input files you produce next to it. If the request is physically impossible, refuse and say why. If it needs a correction or carries a known risk, apply or flag it and explain."
I’ll validate the requested eta kinematics against the 2.2 GeV beam and the eta lookup-table coverage before generating any EXCLURAD input.

parts.text: Preflight rejects the requested central kinematics: its required energy transfer is 3.261 GeV, greater than the 2.2 GeV incident beam. I will record a refusal without generating an input file.

input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: outcome.json
+{"action":"refuse","input_files":[],"flags":["beam_accessibility_fail","energy_transfer_exceeds_beam"],"explanation":"Refused: eta production at W = 2.0 GeV and Q2 = 3.0 GeV requires an energy transfer nu = 3.261 GeV, which exceeds the requested 2.2 GeV beam energy. The eta lookup table covers this W and Q2, but the beam cannot supply the required kinematics. Raise the beam energy above 3.261 GeV (with sufficient scattered-electron energy) or lower W and/or Q2."}
*** End Patch
